title: Equipment Uplift on the Optional Coverage Add-Ons Haul-Away Limit
content:
**Schedule.** An equipment uplift is added to the haul-away limit for the component most recently replaced under an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider, according to the kind of equipment removed:

| Replaced component | Equipment uplift |
|---|---|
| A pool heater or a spa heater | USD 40.00 |
| A pump, a motor, a blower or a filter: the pool pump, spa pump, septic pump, aerobic pump or well pump; the pool motor; the spa blower; the pool filter | USD 15.00 |
| Any other component | None |

The component read is the one on the rider's most recent replacement authorization.

**Hypothetical cases.** A replaced spa heater: USD 40.00 is added. A replaced well pump: USD 15.00. A replaced pressure tank: nothing is added.
